title: DEEPSEA CHALLENGER 深潛工程
summary: 以DEEPSEA CHALLENGER科學影像系統作案例，分析拍攝、照明、樣本與電源互相競爭的資源；以假資料學習資料可用率，不模仿極深載人作業。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use DEEPSEA CHALLENGER scientific imaging as a case for competition among cameras, lighting, samples and electrical power. Learn data availability with synthetic records, without imitating extreme-depth crewed operations. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 把觀察深度換成假設壓差：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Convert observation depth into assumed pressure difference: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 把觀察深度換成假設壓差 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Convert observation depth into assumed pressure difference and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 把觀察深度換成假設壓差：靜水壓差由上方水柱重量造成；表壓與絕對壓力相差水面壓力。 本步以「深度與靜水壓差」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Convert observation depth into assumed pressure difference: Hydrostatic pressure difference comes from the water-column weight; gauge and absolute pressure differ by surface pressure. Use Depth and hydrostatic pressure difference to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是DEEPSEA CHALLENGER 深潛工程實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，g=9.81 m/s²，教學深度h=106 m。式 Δp=ρgh，基準結果 1.0658565 MPa。條件：定密度線性近似；深海精算須積分密度剖面。本式不能給出耐壓艙安全深度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of DEEPSEA CHALLENGER deep-diving engineering: ρ=1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², hypothetical depth h=106 m. Formula Δp=ρgh gives 1.0658565 MPa. Conditions: Constant-density linear approximation; deep-ocean calculations require integrating density profiles. This does not establish a housing’s safe depth.
steps.failure: 把MPa當bar會造成十倍錯誤；壓力曲線合理也不能證明結構耐壓能力。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating MPa as bar causes a tenfold error; a plausible pressure trace does not establish structural pressure resistance. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 用虛構壓力記錄減去水面讀值，檢查零點、單位和隨深度斜率；禁止以自製容器加壓驗證。 本案例另須檢查「把觀察深度換成假設壓差」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Subtract surface readings from synthetic pressure records and inspect zero, units and depth slope; do not validate by pressurizing homemade vessels. Also check that Convert observation depth into assumed pressure difference and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：把觀察深度換成假設壓差。在影像任務板、電力計、壓力曲線與儲存試算表完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加深度10%，以同一密度比較壓差。 算式區的基準值為1.0658565，改變後為1.1724421 MPa。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Convert observation depth into assumed pressure difference. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Imaging mission board, power meter, pressure trace and storage spreadsheet. Increase depth alone by 10% and compare pressure difference at fixed density. Baseline 1.0658565 changes to 1.1724421 MPa. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.text: 本單元任務：檢查相機模組加入後的浮力帳。在影像任務板、電力計、壓力曲線與儲存試算表完成資料或紙面模型練習。只把排水體積增加10%，核對浮力是否增加10%。 算式區的基準值為852.6852，改變後為937.95372 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Check buoyancy after adding a camera module. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Imaging mission board, power meter, pressure trace and storage spreadsheet. Increase only displaced volume by 10% and check a 10% increase in buoyancy. Baseline 852.6852 changes to 937.95372 N.
